annotations.title: Decode calldata: function and arguments of an EVM call

description: Decode EVM transaction calldata into the function and its arguments with viem: give the function signature (transfer(address,uint256)), or leave it out to try common ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, WETH, permit and multicall functions by selector. Numbers come back as decimal strings. Use to read what a pending or past transaction does before signing; get calldata from eth_tx. A selector that does not match is 422, uncharged. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

data.description: 0x calldata (selector plus ABI-encoded arguments), up to 8 KB

signature.description: Optional function signature such as transfer(address,uint256)
